name: Art Quilt
character: Gallery-led, dark ground, large imagery, minimal chrome.

sections.title: {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Art quilts, fiber sculpture, and surface design. A small membership, a serious hanging committee.

items.title: Exhibitions
items.body: Two member shows a year, plus a juried open call in the fall.

items.title: Critique
items.body: A seated critique after every meeting. Bring work in progress or a finished piece.

items.title: Studio visits
items.body: Three visits a year to members who dye, print, or quilt on a longarm.

sections.title: Membership is limited
sections.body: We keep the roster small so critique stays useful. Apply below.

sections.title: Exhibitions
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Hung in a borrowed gallery downtown. Receptions on the first Friday.

sections.html: Work must be ready to hang: a sleeve, a label, and a written statement of no more than 150 words. The hanging committee photographs every piece for the archive.

sections.title: Members' work
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A standing gallery of current work, updated after each critique.

sections.html: To add a piece, send a photograph and the statement to the archive chair after it has been through critique. We do not post work that has not been discussed.

sections.title: About the collective
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} started as a critique group and kept the format when it became a guild.

sections.html:
We meet {{meeting_info}} in {{city}}. Business is ten minutes. Critique is the rest of the evening. Visiting artists may sit in once; after that they apply.

Dues cover the gallery rent for member shows and a modest honorarium for the juror of the open call.

items.quote: The first critique I sat through changed how I finish edges. Nobody was unkind. Nobody was vague either.
items.author: N. Reyes

sections.title: Apply to join
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A short statement, three images, and a conversation with two members.

items.q: Do I have to work only in fiber?
items.a: The hanging committee accepts fiber as the primary material. Paint, stitch, dye, and found cloth all count.
Yes, when the roster is full. We open seats when a member goes inactive for a year.
